name: our_placement_completes
note: Our own ball placement (we are yellow, BALL_PLACEMENT_YELLOW) to (2.0, -3.0), the ball 4 m away at (-2.0, -3.0), the opponents in their default formation. The placement must complete: placement_completes (the referee leaves our placement with the ball within BALL_PLACEMENT_DONE_DISTANCE of the designated position), and we must commit no referee foul ("*"). requires: our robot comes within 1 m of the ball and our placement lasts 1 s.
known_failure: cause (diagnosed, not fixed): the placer's approach point is 0.10 m behind the ball, on the side away from the robot. Robot 4 comes from (1, -2), and its straight run to that point passes 0.03 m from the ball. The planner does not treat the ball as an obstacle for our own placement (motion_planning/src/fastpathplanning/planner.py:1724: the ball keep-out applies only when _keeps_off_ball, planner.py:108, which is false for our restart), so robot 4 drives into the ball from the east, moving west, and pushes it west at about 0.4 m/s. That is above the 0.3 m/s settle speed in BallPlacementOursStep, so it never releases, and each tick it chases the approach point (custom_referee/actions.py:551-570), which moves with the ball. It reaches (-4.2, -3.3) when the 10 s placement timeout hands over. Fixing it means routing the placer around the ball (a staging point, or the ball as an obstacle for the placer): a design choice in the placement skill and the planner, so it is not changed here.
